en.headline: Education Bureau posts 2026/27 kindergarten profiles online
en.dek: The overview lists basic information for about 930 kindergartens and kindergarten-cum-child care centres, including fees, staffing, student numbers and support for non-Chinese-speaking and special-needs children.
body: The Education Bureau on Thursday published the online version of the Profile of Kindergartens and Kindergarten-cum-Child Care Centres for the 2026/27 school year.

The profile contains basic information on about 930 kindergartens and centres across Hong Kong. Details include the list of schools joining the Kindergarten Education Scheme, approved fees, numbers and qualifications of principals and teachers, student enrolment, pupil-teacher ratios, curriculum information, reference prices for major education items, application and registration fees, and admission arrangements.

Separate sections cover support for non-Chinese-speaking children and children with special needs. For schools in the scheme, the profile shows the approved tuition fee after government subsidy deduction. Participating kindergartens must also disclose the proportion of expenditure on major items and undergo quality reviews; the profile indicates whether reviewed schools met the specified standards and links to the latest reports.
The bureau said the information aims to improve transparency so parents can make better-informed school choices for their children.

zh.headline: 教育局發布2026/27學年幼稚園概覽網上版
zh.dek: 載列全港約930所幼稚園及幼稚園暨幼兒中心基本資料，包括學費、師資、學生人數，以及對非華語及有特殊需要學童的支援。
body: 教育局周四發布《幼稚園及幼稚園暨幼兒中心概覽》2026/27學年網上版。
概覽載列全港約930所幼稚園及中心的基本資料，包括參加幼稚園教育計劃的名單、核准學費、校長及教師人數和學歷、學生人數、師生比例、課程資料、主要教育用品參考價目、報名費、註冊費及入學申請資料。
概覽另設「對非華語學童的支援」及「對有特殊需要的學童的支援」欄目。參加計劃的幼稚園會顯示扣減政府資助後的核准學費，並須公開主要開支範圍的支出比例。所有參加計劃的幼稚園須接受質素評核，概覽會顯示已完成評核的學校是否達到指定標準，並連結最近期報告。
教育局表示，有關資料旨在提升學校透明度，讓家長為子女選校時掌握更多資訊。
